---
name: New finding
about: Something you measured or worked out about the game or the compiler
title: "Finding: "
labels: enhancement
---

<!-- Findings are text. Do not attach recordings, saves, captures, byte listings or any of the game's files, and do not
     paste decompiler output. Cite a function by its name or its retail address. -->

**What you found**

One or two sentences.

**How you know**

What you measured and how: a byte comparison, an emulator run, a capture, a file and line of the game's source release.
Name the executable you measured (its SHA-256, as the README gives it) and the tool or method.

**How a maintainer can check it**

The cheapest check that would show it wrong.

**Where it might belong**

A function, a note under `notes/`, a divergence from the published source, or another repository (game behaviour and
file formats go to onslaught-preservation; port behaviour goes to onslaught-ce).
